name: dsys-xiding01
description: Xiding design system, the business-card editor, and the introduction (slide deck, official site and one-page overview) in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p cards/xiding-card/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bundle.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:app && npm run test:tools
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:tools && npm run test && npm run test:engine && npm run build && npm run check:ds && npm run render-check
scripts.build:card: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tools/build-card.ts brand/xiding-guangren-vi design-system/components/bundle.js out/xiding-card.html --people private/people.json
scripts.build:tools: mkdir -p out && npm run build:card && npm run build:card:public
